Verify a hand-entered study identity against Study Tracker

Source: R/study_qhs.R
study_verify.Rd

Compares the identity typed into _study.yml with the study's Study Tracker record and, when they agree, records it as verified with study_update_identity(). Checkpoints held back for an unverified identity are then delivered by study_checkpoint_push().

Usage

study_verify(root = getwd(), replace = FALSE)

Arguments

root

The study root. Defaults to the working directory.

replace

TRUE to replace a typed identity that differs from the Study Tracker record with that record. Defaults to FALSE.

Value

TRUE, invisibly, once the identity is verified. Stops with an error otherwise.

Details

Runs the qhsprograms study-setup --verify command on the LRI servers, which reads Study Tracker with the credentials in ~/.config/study-setup/tracker.env. Those credentials are loaded into that command's process only. Verification against Study Tracker is planned and not yet available to every account; without the credentials file the function stops and says so.

When the typed identity differs from the record, the differences are printed and, by default, nothing changes. Check them, then call again with replace = TRUE to take the Study Tracker record in place of the typed identity; the differences are printed again first. This works in RStudio, where the command cannot ask. In R started from a terminal the command also offers the replacement itself ([y/N], default no). replace = TRUE needs the qhsprograms study-setup that has --accept-tracker.

See also

study_update_identity(), study_checkpoint_push(), study_status()

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
# On the LRI servers, from inside the study:
study_verify()
# After checking the differences it printed:
study_verify(replace = TRUE)
} # }
